title: Observation Legacy
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned heavy—\u201cThe First Observer left a final warning: inheriting this legacy completely will forever forfeit the chance of reincarnation.\u201d

text.content: The night wind whimpered, scattering the lingering warmth of the campfire. Chen Nian's footsteps faded into the distance, yet the words he left behind echoed endlessly in Chen Ji's mind: no matter which path was chosen, the Chen bloodline would endure forever. And at this moment, the will of the Heavenly Eye was gathering on the horizon—the final battle to rewrite destiny was about to begin.

Just as Chen Ji gazed at the night sky, the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms suddenly blazed with scorching heat. That dormant turtle shell divine artifact—the ancient relic he had never fully comprehended—now broke free on its own, hovering mid-air, emanating a ghostly blue glow. Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged from the fragment, carrying an unprecedented solemnity.

dialogue.content: \u201cIt is time.\u201d Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly materialized from the fragment, his aged face appearing especially grave in the blue light, \u201cThe final legacy left by the First Observer will fully awaken tonight. Chen Ji, are you prepared?\u201d

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, his expression remaining as calm as ever, only the fingertips hidden in his sleeves subtly tightened. \u201cPlease speak, Senior.\u201d His voice was placid as still water, yet beneath his calm exterior, terrifying waves churned. The cracks on the Tianji Record Fragment were healing, while the patterns on the turtle shell artifact's surface began spreading frantically, as if something was awakening.

dialogue.content: \u201cThis turtle shell artifact is called \u2018Observation Legacy\u2019—it's the culmination of the First Observer\u2019s lifelong efforts.\u201d Mo Xiansheng walked slowly toward the hovering turtle shell, his remnant soul-body faintly resonating with light, \u201cIt shares the same origin as the Tianji Record—one is the Eye of Observation, the other is the Pen of Recording. Only when the two unite can one glimpse the ultimate mysteries of destiny.\u201d

text.content: The turtle shell artifact suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light, interweaving with the ghostly blue of the Tianji Record Fragment, weaving a complex web of light. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center, and the scene before his eyes instantly shifted—he saw a vast star sea, and a white-robed figure standing in its center, gazing down upon the rise and fall of countless realms.

dialogue.content: \u201cThat is the First Observer.\u201d Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed within the illusion, \u201cHe saw the truth of the Heavenly Dao—that so-called destiny is merely a cycle, an eternal chess game treating all living beings as mere pieces. Discontent with this, he spent ten thousand years arranging this grand game, solely to nurture a being capable of transcending the Heavenly Dao itself.\u201d

text.content: The illusion dissolved, and Chen Ji returned to the night sky of reality. But the turtle shell artifact had undergone a dramatic transformation—it was no longer a cumbersome shell, but a crystal-clear eye-shaped form, with swirling galaxy-like scenery flowing within its pupil. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of desolation.

dialogue.content: \u201cThis divine artifact is called the \u2018Eye of Destiny Observation.\u2019 It allows its wielder to observe the complete threads of destiny, no longer confined to the three-hour limit.\u201d Mo Xiansheng paused, \u201cBut the price is—each use burns your qualification as an Observer. Until finally, your existence will be completely erased from the river of time.\u201d

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, yet a faint smile actually curved his lips. \u201cSo the First Observer cultivated not an inheritor, but a martyr willing to burn away their own existence to break the Heavenly Dao?\u201d His tone was平静得近乎冷酷？No, his tone was calm to the point of being cold, \u201cInteresting. He has underestimated me.\u201d

dialogue.content: \u201cYou...\u201d Mo Xiansheng paused slightly, then shook his head with a bitter smile, \u201cAs expected, how could one who has reached this point in the Heavenly Dao's chess game be willing to become another's chess piece? But Chen Ji, you must understand—without this divine artifact's power, you cannot possibly contend with the Heavenly Eye.\u201d

text.content: \u201cWho said I intend to contend with it?\u201d Chen Ji raised his hand, grasping the eye-shaped turtle shell artifact in his palm. The icy touch transmitted to his fingertips, and he could feel the terrifying power within it resonating with his Tianji Record Fragment. Yet deep within his eyes, sparks of calculation were leaping frantically.

choice.prompt: Facing the First Observer's ultimate legacy and Mo Xiansheng's expectations, Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Accept the First Observer's arrangement, inherit this legacy and mission, become a key piece in his chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Heavenly Fate Value and Observer Qualification
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete ability of the \u2018Eye of Destiny Observation\u2019 with unlimited foresight range
choices.risk_hint: The price is burning away one's own existence, ultimately forfeiting the chance of reincarnation

dialogue.content: \u201cExcellent!\u201d A relieved expression appeared on Mo Xiansheng's aged face, \u201cIndeed worthy of one chosen by Chen Xuan. Since you choose to inherit the legacy, I shall bestow upon you the complete inheritance of the Observer.\u201d He waved his hand, and the turtle shell artifact suddenly blazed with dazzling light, merging with the Tianji Record Fragment.

choices.description: Did the First Observer truly wish to break the Heavenly Dao, or was there another agenda? Perhaps the chess game itself was a trap.
choices.visible_cost: May anger Mo Xiansheng, miss the optimal timing for the legacy
choices.visible_reward: See through the truth behind the First Observer's grand design, gain the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be far more cruel than imagined

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's expression shifted slightly; after a long silence, he spoke slowly: \u201cYou are indeed more cautious than imagined. The First Observer's purpose... truly runs deeper than this. But some truths, you must discover for yourself.\u201d His words carried a profound meaning.

choices.description: Not follow the First Observer's old path, seek one's own way—there may be a third path.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to obtain complete abilities in the short term, must seek other methods
choices.visible_reward: Maintain personal independence, avoid becoming anyone's chess piece
choices.risk_hint: The process of finding a new path is filled with unknowns and dangers

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's eyes flickered with surprise, then shifted to admiration: \u201cWell said, lad! No wonder you can scheme beneath everyone's eyes while appearing worthless. But I must warn you—the path of independent exploration... is far more dangerous than you imagine.\u201d

text.content: At this moment, the Eye of Destiny Observation suddenly trembled violently. The galaxy within its pupil began spinning frantically, and a boundless stream of information surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—the final memory left by the First Observer, showing that white-robed figure confronting a massive eye.

\u201cThe Heavenly Eye...\u201d Chen Ji heard the First Observer whisper within the memory, \u201cDo you think you control destiny? Laughable, you merely execute the will of an even older existence. And what I intend to do is end this cycle completely.\u201d The memory cut off abruptly here, dissolving into countless motes of light scattered across the Void.

dialogue.content: \u201cDo you understand now?\u201d Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and weary, \u201cWhat the First Observer sought to oppose was not merely the Heavenly Eye, but the existence manipulating everything behind it. And his chess game... calculated you in from the very beginning.\u201d

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, the ghostly glow of the Eye of Destiny Observation reflected in his pupils. His expression remained calm, yet a meaningful smile curved his lips. \u201cCalculated me in? That depends on whether he has the skill.\u201d His voice was low, yet carried an undeniable confidence.

dialogue.content: \u201cWhat do you intend to do?\u201d Mo Xiansheng asked, his remnant soul-form wavering slightly in the night wind.

text.content: \u201cThe First Observer wanted me to be a chess piece. I shall do the opposite.\u201d Chen Ji stored the Eye of Destiny Observation in his sleeve, calculation的光芒闪烁在他的眼底，\u201cHe intended to use me to break that \u2018older existence,\u2019 but I want to see—who is the true mastermind behind this chess game.\u201d

choice.prompt: Faced with the First Observer's legacy and truth, Chen Ji decided to take action.

choices.description: Immediately and completely refine the Eye of Destiny Observation, gain the capital to oppose the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value decreases significantly, consume part of Observer Qualification
choices.visible_reward: Combat Power surges tremendously, can fully utilize the Eye of Destiny Observation's abilities
choices.risk_hint: The price is heavy, but gains power at the fastest rate

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, placing the Eye of Destiny Observation between his palms. The ghostly blue and golden light interwove, slowly seeping into his meridians. An unprecedented power surged within his body, as if all the laws governing the world's operation had become crystal clear before his eyes.

choices.description: Delay refinement, first comprehend the knowledge left by the First Observer, understand the true rules of this chess game.
choices.visible_cost: No significant Combat Power increase in the short term
choices.visible_reward: Strategizing ability increases greatly,洞察更多隐藏真相
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal timing, but sets the stage for long-term scheming

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his divine consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record Fragment. Countless runes and patterns emerged within his Mental Sea—these were the First Observer's ten-thousand-year accumulation of observation notes and law insights. He absorbed them like a starving person devouring food, and with each comprehension, his understanding of this world deepened another level.

choices.description: Chen Nian's existence can interfere with Tianji Record's foresight—perhaps she is the key to breaking this chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon current opportunity, embark on an unknown journey to find kin
choices.visible_reward: Obtain entirely new possibilities to change destiny
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian is controlled by the Holy Sect, acting rashly carries extreme risk

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, gazing into the distance, a rare softness flickering in his eyes. \u201cThe First Observer schemed for ten thousand years, calculating every hero under heaven, yet failed to account for a single variable—Chen Nian.\u201d A smile curved his lips, \u201cLet me see what happens if I introduce this variable into the chess game.\u201d

Mo Xiansheng watched Chen Ji's choices silently, his remnant soul-form swaying in the night wind. He suddenly spoke, his voice carrying rare respect: \u201cYou are different from all previous Observers. They were either bound by duty or dazzled by power—only you...\u201d He paused, \u201cMaintain absolute clarity from beginning to end.\u201d

dialogue.content: \u201cIs this a compliment?\u201d Chen Ji smiled faintly, \u201cClarity can sometimes be a kind of pain. Senior, I have a question—the memory left by the First Observer, did he intend for me to see it, or was it my own choice?\u201d

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while before finally sighing: \u201cThis question... perhaps even I do not know the answer. But one thing is certain—the First Observer schemed for ten thousand years, yet never truly fathomed the human heart. He believed burning himself would break the cycle, not knowing the true variable has always resided within the human heart.\u201d

Chen Ji rose slowly, storing both the Tianji Record Fragment and the Eye of Destiny Observation in his bosom. Upon contact with the fragment, the turtle shell artifact burst forth with gentle light, and the two objects of shared origin began merging slowly. His aura shifted accordingly, as if some shackle was loosening.

dialogue.content: \u201cSince that is the case, I shall give you one piece of advice.\u201d Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became especially serious, \u201cThe First Observer left a final warning—if you choose to completely inherit this legacy, the price will not merely be Heavenly Fate Value and Observer Qualification.\u201d He paused, \u201cYou will forever forfeit the chance of reincarnation. Death means complete annihilation.\u201d

text.content: The night wind suddenly turned biting, rustling Chen Ji's robes violently. He stood motionless, his face betraying no expression, yet within the depths of his eyes, a complex light flickered. This price... was heavier than anticipated. But his lips, conversely, curved into a serene smile.

\u201cReincarnation?\u201d Chen Ji softly repeated these words, his voice carrying a hint of imperceptible mockery, \u201cIf one cannot even live this life clearly, what use is speaking of the next? Senior, watch and see—I will use this one lifetime to forge a path even the First Observer never walked.\u201d

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng gazed at the back of this young man before him, momentarily seeing glimpses of that other white-robed figure from ten thousand years ago, equally triumphant in his bearing. But Chen Ji was different—more composed, more rational, more dangerous. \u201cVery well.\u201d Mo Xiansheng said softly, \u201cThen let this old man see how far you can go.\u201d

text.content: At the horizon, the first light of dawn began to emerge. Chen Ji turned, gazing at the sky dyed red by the morning glow, his eyes reflecting the strange light born from the fusion of the Eye of Destiny Observation and the Tianji Record Fragment. A greater storm was brewing, and he—had already prepared to face everything.

The morning wind brushed past, carrying the distant sounds of battle cries. Somewhere on the battlefield, disciples from the three great sects were locked in fierce combat with the Demonic Path forces; somewhere in the depths of a mountain, strange black qi seeped from where Elder Ling Yuan was in seclusion; somewhere in the depths of a forbidden land, the will of the Heavenly Eye was slowly awakening. And all of this would be witnessed by the just-awakened \u201cEye of Destiny Observation.\u201d
